header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the applicant; nor intimation received.
body: After filing this Criminal Misc. Application, same was fixed in court on 02-07-2026, 17-09-2026, 29-09-2026 and 28-10- 2026, but on all the previous dates of hearing applicant and his counsel remained absent, which reflects that applicant and his counsel have lost their interest to proceed with this matter, therefore, instant Criminal Misc. Application alongwith listed pending application stands dismissed for nonprosecution.
